prompts.menu: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production HD Red Alert 2 campaign-selection background. Image 1 is the authoritative ORIGINAL 632 x 568 game panel; repaint this exact panel at 2528 x 2272, or the highest possible resolution with the exact original aspect. This is a faithful HD restoration, not a redesign or screenshot. Keep every anchor, scale, silhouette, empty margin and layout precisely. Top: the exact silver-blue Allied eagle, sharp feather blades and head, backed by its original open triangular bracket. Middle: the same tan round steel helmet over two crossed wooden bolt-action rifles with long silver bayonets. Bottom: the exact red Soviet globe, golden five-pointed star and golden hammer and sickle with the same angle and proportions. Retain the original dark black background and fine subdued dark-red geographical continent/state outlines; no extra bright patterns, labels or arbitrary map decorations. Preserve the extremely thin brushed-silver beveled outside frame and corners. Add crisp metal bevels, finely resolved wings, helmet rim and bayonets, clean pole/trigger/wood contours, polished original red/gold emblem surfaces and smooth antialiased edges. Match original early-2000s 3D RTS menu aesthetic and colors, not painterly. Do not add buttons, difficulty controls, arrows, text, letters, captions, logos, watermark, new weapons, symbols, people, lighting flares or sci-fi ornament. No blur, nearest-neighbor pixel edges, noise or JPEG artifacts. Original controls and seven-frame hover arrows are separate live elements and must not be baked into this background. Fill the entire original rectangular panel, opaque black background.
prompts.loading: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production HD Red Alert 2 Soviet mission 01 loading illustration. Image 1 is the authoritative 800 x 520 original artwork, not a screenshot. Faithfully repaint exactly this composition at 3200 x 2080, or the highest possible matching aspect; do not redesign it. Preserve every region, border, original color-coded political map shape, orange inset frame and connecting line anchor, exact image locations, aspect and black negative spaces. Keep the full-world backdrop with the original blue/red/green/purple land regions and thin dark red graticule. The orange framed inset must remain the eastern USA, Great Lakes and Gulf/Caribbean, with its original blue land areas, Washington DC target shield and large red airborne invasion arrow pointing at that shield; preserve the three black parachute silhouettes. Bottom left retain the same large red Soviet globe with golden star and original hammer/sickle, with crisp polished metal bevels. Bottom center keep the three separate original miniature pictures at their original locations: the Soviet soldier portrait, destroyed/crushed Liberty scene, and the original gray Soviet tank with its gun pointing upper right. Bottom right retain the same pink-red-tinted aerial photograph of the Pentagon, a real recognizable five-sided building with inner courtyard and five rings, same crop/angle/placement. Keep the original slender silver beveled outside frame. Sharpen geographical coastlines, fine boundaries, graticule, metallic symbols and the three miniatures with genuine painted detail. Smooth antialiased clean vector-like edges for maps and invasion graphics; faithful detailed classic RTS rendered/photographic collage materials. No new banners, text, labels, names, numbers, HUD, progress bar, mission objectives or title: those are separate live localized controls. No invented countries, altered geography, rotated frames, extra symbols, blurred pixels or modern UI styling. Opaque black background and no transparency.

revisions.menu: Edit target: Image 1, the freshly generated Red Alert 2 campaign panel. Only reduce the brightness of the background red geographical map linework to approximately one quarter of its current intensity, so it is a barely visible dark-maroon texture against near-black, matching the original game. Keep the exact current eagle, helmet/rifles, Soviet emblem, all their colors, positions, shapes, highlights and sharp details COMPLETELY unchanged. Keep the brushed silver outer border unchanged. No text, controls, buttons, new artwork or new details. Same image size and aspect, no cropping. This is a restrained background luminance correction only.
revisions.loading: Faithful high-resolution restoration of the supplied nonviolent video-game menu illustration. It is a static vintage strategy-game loading infographic, with no scene of combat or injury. Preserve exactly the source layout, map geography, color-coded land areas, thin map grid and orange rectangular inset and connector shapes. Preserve the small target shield and graphic red pointer with three black parachute icons. Preserve the bottom-left historical red/gold Soviet game emblem with the original five-point star, globe and hammer/sickle. Preserve the three small archival-style postcard thumbnails at bottom center in exactly the same positions, and the pink-tinted static aerial architectural photograph of the five-sided Pentagon at bottom right, same placement and crop. The tank thumbnail is a stationary museum/display vehicle, with no firing. No explosions, fire, blood, people being harmed, damaged buildings or violent imagery. Repaint with crisp clean map contours, clean smooth borders, polished emblem bevels and photographic detail, matching the original palette and classic 3D strategy-game UI. Do not add text, labels, numbers, flags, new symbols, HUD or progress controls. Black background, slender original silver outer frame. Exact 800:520 composition, highest output resolution; target 3200 x 2080. Preserve every original location and scale, no redesign.
revisions.loadingEmblem: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated historical strategy-game UI emblem. Image 1 is the authoritative original 210 x 200 icon crop. Faithfully repaint ONLY the red globe, golden five-pointed star, golden hammer and sickle as a crisp high-resolution 3D rendered game icon, preserving the exact original tilted perspective, overlapping order, silhouette, angles and composition. Keep the original warm polished gold bevels, red globe shell, curved metallic rim and dark inset facets, with sharp smooth contours and fine material detail. Preserve the original star tip locations and the original hammer angle. Remove all black background, faint red grid, orange line fragments and unrelated background marks to genuine transparent alpha. No new symbols, text, border, badge shape, scenery, weapons or people. This is a static menu asset, no scene or action. Highest resolution, square-ish 21:20 canvas with clear transparent margins. Do not rotate, crop or redesign the source symbol.

loadingScope: Two full-scene repaint attempts were rejected. The menu, isolated emblem and four separate photo slots were then authored with the built-in tool and registered with source-backed vector geography/chrome. No CLI/API fallback was used.
